page1.title: Welcome to Rapid Recap Tournament!
page1.content1: Welcome to the exciting world of Rapid Recap Tournament!
page1.content2: This weekend event is your chance to showcase your knowledge, compete with others, and have a blast while learning new things.
page1.content3: Get ready for a thrilling quiz experience that covers various categories and keeps you up-to-date with current affairs!

page2.title: Eligibility and Registration
page2.content1: To join the tournament mode, you need to have: a 2-day quiz streak, OR complete 3 quizzes under 30 minutes, OR complete 6 quizzes in a day, OR achieve an RQM score greater than 42 in 2 quizzes in a day. This ensures you're ready to compete!. It's like building your quiz power!
page2.content2: Registration is open from Monday to Friday until 11 PM. Don't miss your chance to enter the arena of knowledge!
page2.content3: During registration, you'll choose 5 categories out of 15 exciting options. Plus, everyone gets to tackle the 'Current Affairs' category!

page3.title: Tournament Structure
page3.content1: The big event happens every Saturday and Sunday. You can participate at any time during these two days!
page3.content2: You'll face 5 questions from each of your chosen categories, plus 5 from Current Affairs. That's a total of 30 brain-teasing questions!
page3.content3: The Current Affairs questions come about global events from the last 5 days, keeping you in the loop!

page4.title: Quiz Challenge
page4.content1: Here's where the adrenaline kicks in: you have just 50 seconds to answer 5 questions. It's a true test of speed and knowledge!
page4.content2: Don't stress if you can't answer them all. The goal is to have fun and learn something new with every quiz.
page4.content3: Remember, practice makes perfect. The more you play, the better you'll get at tackling these rapid-fire questions!

page5.title: Scoring and Leaderboard
page5.content1: After completing the quiz, you'll see how you stack up against other players on our real-time leaderboard.
page5.content2: Your ranking is based on your total RQM (Rapid Quiz Master) score, which combines your performance across all categories.
page5.content3: The leaderboard updates instantly, so you'll always know where you stand in the heat of the competition!

page6.title: Final Tips and Good Luck!
page6.content1: Stay curious and keep learning! The tournament is designed to be both fun and educational.
page6.content2: Don't forget to brush up on current affairs. It might give you the edge you need to climb the leaderboard!
page6.content3: Most importantly, enjoy the experience. Whether you're aiming for the top spot or just having fun, you're part of an epic quest for knowledge!
page6.content4: Good luck, Rapid Recapper! May your mind be quick and your answers true! 🏆🎉
